title: Latent Factor Varying-Coefficient Regression
text: LFVCR (Latent Factor Varying-Coefficient Regression) R package regression high-dimensional predictors whose effects may vary low-dimensional latent structure. estimates latent factors, constructs factor--feature interactions, fits expanded design sparse group lasso. Two factor-extraction methods available: LF_VCR() first estimates number factors (p_hat) GrFA::est_num(), extracts factors using unscaled PCA (scale. = FALSE). LF_VCR_ae() uses GrFA::est_num() estimate width single-hidden-layer autoencoder, number.K need supplied.

title: Latent Factor Varying-Coefficient Regression
text: binary outcome, set categorical = TRUE provide outcome exactly two distinct values. second factor level modeled 1 level order returned outcome_levels. Additional adjustment variables can supplied covariate.
code: library(LFVCR)  set.seed(1) n <- 120 p <- 30 true_factors <- matrix(rnorm(n * 2), nrow = n) loadings <- matrix(rnorm(p * 2), nrow = p) X <- true_factors %*% t(loadings) +   matrix(rnorm(n * p, sd = 0.35), nrow = n) y <- true_factors[, 1] - 0.5 * true_factors[, 2] + rnorm(n)  fit <- LF_VCR(   X = X,   y = y,   nfold = 5,   kmax = 8,   factor_criterion = "BIC3" )  fit$p_hat fit$beta

title: Latent Factor Varying-Coefficient Regression
text: LF_VCR() returns estimated p_hat, PCA factors, PCA fit, cross-validated sparse group lasso model, coefficients lambda.min. LF_VCR_ae() returns p_hat together corresponding autoencoder regression results. factor extraction, functions use factor--feature interactions, group assignments, Gaussian/binomial model fitting code.

title: Fit LF-VCR with PCA latent factors — LF_VCR
text: X numeric matrix observations rows predictors columns. y numeric outcome vector one value per row X. covariate optional matrix adjustment covariates. nfold number cross-validation folds used sparsegl::cv.sparsegl(). kmax maximum number factors considered GrFA::est_num(). factor_criterion criterion passed GrFA::est_num() estimating p_hat. default "BIC3". categorical Logical; use binomial model TRUE Gaussian model FALSE. binary outcome, second factor level modeled 1 levels returned outcome_levels.

title: Fit LF-VCR with PCA latent factors — LF_VCR
text: list containing estimated factor count p_hat, extracted PCA factors, fitted pca object, cross-validated sparse group lasso model, beta coefficients lambda.min, binary outcome_levels applicable.

title: Fit LF-VCR with PCA latent factors — LF_VCR
